### The Time of Harvest
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-time-of-harvest
Passage: Revelation 14:14-20
Points:
- God assures believers facing persecution that those who persist in wickedness will be repaid.
- Apparent delays in justice are not true delays, as judgment occurs at the exact time God has appointed.
- The vision of the winepress stresses that God's final judgment will be completely thorough, leaving no wicked person unaccounted for.
- Christians can endure evil with patience, resting in God's perfect timing and leaving all vengeance in His hands.
